name: pg_weave
abstract: One index for BM25 text, vector similarity, fuzzy and regex search
description: A PostgreSQL extension providing a single unified index access method (weave) that combines BM25 lexical full-text ranking, vector similarity, fuzzy (edit-distance) matching, and regex/trigram search, so applications no longer need to maintain separate GIN/GiST/vector indexes for hybrid retrieval.
